question: Should the public repository name be retained as “moltinators,” changed to “OpenClawtinators,” or renamed to another explicitly approved canonical form?
rationale: The one-line implementation is mechanically simple, but no supplied source establishes that “OpenClawtinators” is the approved public identity, and another open PR overlaps the same documentation surface.

options.title: Confirm OpenClawtinators
options.body: Approve “OpenClawtinators” as the canonical name, then merge or recreate one narrow README change and close the competing PR.

options.title: Keep current naming
options.body: Retain the current canonical name and close both competing README rename proposals as not aligned with the chosen identity.

options.title: Choose another canonical name
options.body: Record the approved name in repository documentation and ask for one focused follow-up PR that updates all intended public references.

recommendation.title: Keep current naming
recommendation.body: Retain the current canonical name and close both competing README rename proposals as not aligned with the chosen identity.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context ties this account to the proposed public name, while repository history could not be inspected in the restricted review environment.
